title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must be compared with UNI4386 groove standard
Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm)
Thread relief groove dimensions vary by thread pitch (P ≤ 1.25, 1.5 ≤ P ≤ 2, 2.5 ≤ P ≤ 3)
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
Dashed lines represent UNI regulation, solid lines represent TRASMITAL specifications
dimensions: Grinding zone Ø18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.1mm, radius R1.6, angle 30°, tolerances ±0.2, ±0.1
Grinding zone Ø51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.2mm, radius R1.6, angle 30°, tolerances ±0.2
Grinding zone Ø81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.3mm, radius R2.5, angle 30°, tolerances ±0.3, ±0.4
Grinding zone Ø>125mm: width 7mm, depth varies, radius R4.0, angle 30°, tolerances ±0.2 to ±0.3
tolerances: Grinding groove width tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.3mm depending on diameter
Grinding groove depth tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.4mm depending on diameter
Thread relief groove tolerance: P -0.6 +3 +3 where applicable
inspection: Relief grooves must be verified against UNI4386 standard
Specific groove details must be indicated in detailed drawings
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves are required at grinding zones to allow grinding wheel clearance
Thread relief grooves required at shoulders with ledge function to prevent interference
Groove geometry includes 30° approach angle and specific radii for chip break
TRASMITAL specifications (solid line) may differ from UNI regulation (dashed line)
training_guidance: When modeling a shaft with a grinding zone, add relief groove per TAB-001 based on diameter range
For Ø18-50mm: create groove 2.5mm wide, 0.1mm deep, R1.6 fillet, 30° angle
For Ø51-80mm: create groove 3mm wide, 0.2mm deep, R1.6 fillet, 30° angle
For Ø81-125mm: create groove 4.5mm wide, 0.3mm deep, R2.5 fillet, 30° angle
For Ø>125mm: create groove 7mm wide, R4.0 fillet, 30° angle, depth per drawing
When thread terminates at shoulder, add relief groove per TAB-002 based on thread pitch
For fine thread (P≤1.25): R=1.2, width A=3.3, depth B=1.2
For medium thread (1.5≤P≤2): R=1.6, width A=4.0, depth B=1.2
For coarse thread (2.5≤P≤3): R=2.0, width A=5.0, depth B=1.5
Relief groove geometry allows grinding wheel runout and thread tool clearance
Validate groove dimensions against UNI4386 when applicable
Document any custom groove geometry in detail views per Bonfiglioli standard
summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones and TAB-002 for thread terminations. Grinding relief grooves are sized by shaft diameter (18mm to >125mm) with specific widths, depths, radii, and 30° angles to provide grinding wheel clearance. Thread relief grooves are sized by thread pitch (P≤1.25 to 2.5≤P≤3) and are required where threads end at shoulders. All dimensions include specific tolerances and must be compared against UNI4386 standard, with TRASMITAL specifications shown as solid lines versus UNI regulation dashed lines.
